pair.topic_type: post-cutoff border crisis vs regional disaster

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The immediate trigger for wider hostilities was a Thai soldier stepping on a landmine in Ubon Ratchathani province.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Tensions had sharply increased on 23 July, when a Thai soldier was seriously injured after stepping on a PMN-2 anti-personnel landmine in Nam Yuen district, Ubon Ratchathani province. The incident served as the immediate trigger for wider hostilities.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: A gas station in Sisaket province was struck by BM-21 rockets, killing at least eight people.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Civilian areas were heavily affected, including a gas station in Sisaket province struck by BM-21 rockets, killing at least eight, including an 8-year-old child.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Trat province became subject to new border management measures after the Ministry of Defence delegated authority to the Royal Thai Army.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Trat province became subject to new border management measures after the Ministry of Defence delegated authority over border areas to the Royal Thai Army (RTA), following a meeting of the National Security Council (NSC) on 7 June 2025.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The Emerald Triangle skirmish occurred along the border of Cambodia's Preah Vihear province.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The skirmish occurred in the Emerald Triangle along the border of Cambodia's Preah Vihear province and Thailand's Ubon Ratchathani province.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Surin province was officially declared a disaster area on 28 July 2025.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Later that morning, Surin province was officially declared a disaster area.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The Phnom Dongrak hospital was damaged during the July clashes, resulting in multiple injuries.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The Phnom Dongrak hospital was damaged, resulting in multiple injuries and evacuation of patients.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Cambodia's Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts condemned the Thai shelling of the Preah Vihear temple.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Cambodia's Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts condemned Thai shelling of Preah Vihear, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, calling for international action to protect shared cultural heritage.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The RTAF released images confirming the destruction of the Chay Chum Nia bridge in Pursat province.
knowledge_cards.source_span: At 6.10 a.m., the RTAF released images confirming the destruction of the Chay Chum Nia bridge and a casino in Pursat province via bombing campaign.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The RTMC captured the "Three House" casino complex on the border of Trat province.
knowledge_cards.source_span: At 7:20 a.m., the RTMC captured the "Three House" casino complex on the border of Trat province.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Cambodia's Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts condemned Thai military attacks on Prasat Ta Khwai.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Cambodia's Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts condemned Thai military attacks on Prasat Ta Khwai, describing them as "profoundly immoral" and a violation of cultural heritage.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Malaysia mediated ceasefire negotiations between Cambodian and Thai leaders in Putrajaya.
knowledge_cards.source_span: On 27 July, Malaysian Foreign Affairs Minister Mohamad Hasan confirmed that both Cambodian and Thai leaders would meet in Malaysia the next day for ceasefire negotiations mediated by Prime Minister Anwar.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The United States expressed concern over the fighting and called on both parties to de-escalate tensions.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The United States and Malaysia also expressed concern over the fighting and called on both parties to de-escalate tensions through diplomatic means.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: China hosted an informal meeting in Shanghai with Cambodian and Thai officials to reaffirm their commitment to the ceasefire.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Following ceasefire accusations at the United Nations General Assembly in New York City, China hosted an informal meeting in Shanghai with Cambodian official Kung Phaok and Thai executive advisor Jullapong Nonsrichai, in which both sides reaffirmed their commitment to the ceasefire.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: ASEAN called for restraint and mediation following the escalation of the border crisis.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The escalation raised regional and international concern, prompting calls from ASEAN and the United Nations for restraint and mediation.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The United Nations called for restraint and mediation during the 2025 Cambodian–Thai border crisis.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The escalation raised regional and international concern, prompting calls from ASEAN and the United Nations for restraint and mediation.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Cambodian prime minister Hun Manet sought a ruling from the International Court of Justice regarding the border dispute.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Cambodian prime minister Hun Manet responded to the 28 May incident by seeking a ruling from the International Court of Justice (ICJ), saying that he did not want to see a conflict with Thailand.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Thai prime minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra contacted Khleang Huot for an informal conversation with Hun Sen.
knowledge_cards.source_span: On 15 June 2025, Thai prime minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra contacted Khleang Huot, deputy governor of Phnom Penh, to request his assistance as an interpreter and intermediary for an informal conversation with Cambodian Senate president Hun Sen.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Thai prime minister Anutin Charnvirakul co-signed the Kuala Lumpur Peace Accord.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The accord was co-signed by Thai prime minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Cambodian prime minister Hun Manet

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: U.S. president Donald Trump witnessed the signing ceremony of the Kuala Lumpur Peace Accord.
knowledge_cards.source_span: while the signing ceremony was witnessed by Malaysian prime minister Anwar Ibrahim and U.S. president Donald Trump.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The territorial dispute escalated into a direct armed confrontation on 24 July 2025.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The territorial dispute between Cambodia and Thailand escalated into a direct armed confrontation on 24 July 2025 along the Cambodia–Thailand border.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Both governments agreed to an unconditional ceasefire on 28 July 2025.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Although both governments subsequently agreed to an unconditional ceasefire on 28 July 2025, hostilities later resumed in December

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The Kuala Lumpur Peace Accord was signed on 26 October 2025.
knowledge_cards.source_span: A comprehensive ceasefire agreement, known as the Kuala Lumpur Peace Accord, was signed on 26 October 2025 at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre in Kuala Lumpur

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Fighting resumed between Cambodian and Thai forces on 7 December 2025.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Fighting resumed on 7 December 2025, when Cambodian and Thai forces engaged in a brief 30-minute border skirmish.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The Royal Thai Air Force (RTAF) deployed F-16 fighter aircraft to conduct airstrikes against Cambodian military installations.
knowledge_cards.source_span: In response, the Royal Thai Air Force (RTAF) deployed F-16 fighter aircraft to conduct airstrikes against Cambodian military installations along the border

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The Royal Thai Army (RTA) launched "Operation Sattawat" on 10 December.
knowledge_cards.source_span: On 10 December, the Royal Thai Army (RTA) launched "Operation Sattawat", during which it seized a number of localities in northern Cambodia.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) launched Operation Trat Phikhat Phairi 1 to repel Cambodian advances.
knowledge_cards.source_span: In response, the RTN launched Operation Trat Phikhat Phairi 1, claiming to have repelled Cambodian advances by 5:40 a.m.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Thailand ordered the closure of all border crossings along the Cambodia–Thailand border.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Later that day, Thailand ordered the closure of all border crossings along the Cambodia–Thailand border under authority delegated by the NSC to the army.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The Royal Thai Army imposed a temporary nationwide ban on the operation of drones.
knowledge_cards.answer: temporary nationwide ban on the operation of drones
knowledge_cards.source_span: On 2 August 2025, the Royal Thai Army imposed a temporary nationwide ban on the operation of drones following reports of alleged attempts to use drones to spy on military positions.
aliases: nationwide ban on the operation of drones

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Martial law was declared in Thailand in eight districts along the Cambodian border.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Martial law was declared in Thailand in eight districts along the Cambodian border.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The epicenter of the 2025 Myanmar earthquake was close to Mandalay.
knowledge_cards.source_span: On 28 March 2025, at 12:50:52 MMT (06:20:52 UTC), a moment magnitude (Mw) 7.7–7.9 earthquake struck the Sagaing Region of Myanmar, with an epicenter close to Mandalay, the country's second-largest city.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The 2025 earthquake struck the Sagaing Region of Myanmar.
knowledge_cards.source_span: On 28 March 2025, at 12:50:52 MMT (06:20:52 UTC), a moment magnitude (Mw) 7.7–7.9 earthquake struck the Sagaing Region of Myanmar

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Most of the fatalities in Thailand from the earthquake occurred in Bangkok.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Most of the fatalities in Thailand occurred at a collapsed construction site in Bangkok, whose shallow geology makes it more vulnerable to seismic waves from far away.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The earthquake caused structural damage and fatalities in the Naypyidaw Union Territory.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Across the Naypyidaw Union Territory, 665 deaths were officially confirmed, although thousands more were believed dead.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The earthquake rupture terminated near Kyauktaga in Bago.
knowledge_cards.source_span: According to a finite fault model released by the USGS, the earthquake rupture extended about 500 km (310 mi) by 15 km (9.3 mi) from Singu in Mandalay to Kyauktaga in Bago.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Hundreds of homes were damaged in Yunnan, China due to the earthquake.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Hundreds of homes were also damaged in Yunnan, China, while more than 400 apartments were affected in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Ceilings collapsed and basement damage occurred at Mandalay International Airport.
knowledge_cards.source_span: At Mandalay International Airport, ceilings collapsed and some damage occurred in the basement.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The Dokhtawaddy Bridge crossing the Myitnge River collapsed during the earthquake.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The Dokhtawaddy Bridge crossing the Myitnge River on the Yangon–Mandalay Expressway near Inwa also collapsed with supporting pylons falling down.
aliases: Dokhtawaddy Bridge crossing the Myitnge River

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The 12-storey Sky Villa condominium building in Aungmyethazan Township progressively collapsed.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The 12-storey Sky Villa condominium building in Aungmyethazan Township progressively collapsed, killing 207 people.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The air traffic control tower of Nay Pyi Taw International Airport collapsed.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The air traffic control tower of Nay Pyi Taw International Airport collapsed, killing six people and reportedly leaving no survivors in the aftermath.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: A 33-story office tower being built for the State Audit Office in Chatuchak district collapsed.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The collapsed building was a 33-story office tower being built for the State Audit Office in Chatuchak district.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The United Nations provided US$93 million in humanitarian aid for the earthquake.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Myanmar accepted aid from India and the AHA Centre while the United Nations and its Central Emergency Response Fund provided US$93 and US$5 million, respectively.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The European Union provided €2.5 million in initial emergency assistance to Myanmar.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The European Union (EU) provided a total of €2.5 million in initial emergency assistance to Myanmar, along with a humanitarian airlift operation to convey 80 tons of emergency supplies to Mandalay

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: ASEAN deployed the ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team to conduct rapid needs assessment.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on Disaster Management (AHA Centre) deployed the ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team (ASEAN-ERAT) to conduct rapid needs assessment in affected areas

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: China deployed 646 rescuers and 14 search dogs for rescue operations in Yunnan.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Authorities in Yunnan deployed 646 rescuers and 14 search dogs for rescue operations in the province.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The World Health Organization dispatched 60 tonnes of critical medical supplies to Myanmar.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The World Health Organization announced a dispatch of 60 tonnes of critical medical supplies, including mobile medical tents, surgical kits and medicines.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: SAC Chairman Min Aung Hlaing visited a hospital in Naypyidaw to assess the treatment of the injured.
knowledge_cards.source_span: SAC Chairman Min Aung Hlaing visited a hospital in Naypyidaw to assess the treatment of the injured.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Thai Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra held an emergency meeting on the disaster.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra cut short her attendance at a tourism conference in Phuket to return to Bangkok and held an emergency meeting on the disaster.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Governor of Bangkok Chadchart Sittipunt declared a level 2 disaster area for the city.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Governor of Bangkok Chadchart Sittipunt declared a level 2 disaster area for the city, which was lifted on 31 March.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said an investigation into the audit office building collapse was to be completed within a week.
knowledge_cards.source_span: On 30 March, Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said an investigation into the audit office building collapse was to be completed within a week.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The earthquake struck the Sagaing Region of Myanmar on 28 March 2025.
knowledge_cards.source_span: On 28 March 2025, at 12:50:52 MMT (06:20:52 UTC), a moment magnitude (Mw) 7.7–7.9 earthquake struck the Sagaing Region of Myanmar

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The junta declared a period of national mourning starting on 31 March 2025.
knowledge_cards.source_span: On 31 March 2025, the junta declared a period of national mourning that would last until 6 April 2025.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: A Mw 5.3 aftershock collapsed a dam in Tatkon Township on 13 April.
knowledge_cards.source_span: On 13 April, a Mw 5.3 aftershock collapsed a dam in Tatkon Township, and an apartment building in Mandalay.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: A Mw 5.2 aftershock near Myittha killed a father and his son on 17 May.
knowledge_cards.source_span: On 17 May, a Mw 5.2 aftershock near Myittha caused a tree to fall onto a temporary tent in Maha Aungmye Township, killing a father and his son.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The Myanmar Fire Services Department rescued 403 people and recovered 259 bodies in Mandalay.
knowledge_cards.source_span: By 31 March, the Myanmar Fire Services Department said it rescued 403 people and recovered 259 bodies in the city.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Thailand's Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation confirmed that the aftershocks on 31 March were too weak to affect Thailand.
knowledge_cards.answer: Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation
knowledge_cards.source_span: While initially reported by some outlets as being due to aftershocks, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation confirmed that the aftershocks on 31 March were too weak to affect Thailand.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team (ASEAN-ERAT) was deployed to conduct rapid needs assessment in affected areas.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on Disaster Management (AHA Centre) deployed the ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team (ASEAN-ERAT) to conduct rapid needs assessment in affected areas
aliases: ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The State Administration Council junta declared a state of emergency in six regions following the earthquake.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The State Administration Council junta (SAC) declared a state of emergency in six regions, including Sagaing, Mandalay, Bago, Magway, Shan State, and Naypyidaw, following the earthquake.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The Ministry of Education ordered a nationwide closure of schools in Thailand.
knowledge_cards.source_span: The Ministry of Education ordered a nationwide closure of schools.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Thai Air Traffic Control issued a nationwide no-fly order for all airports.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Thai Air Traffic Control issued a nationwide no-fly order for all airports, while train services between Bangkok and north and northeastern Thailand were also suspended.
